assets.id: unique id used by the composition map, for example hero-key-visual
assets.file: path of the asset in the project, for example public/assets/hero-key-visual.webp
assets.kind: image | video | illustration | 3d | lottie | svg | font | texture
assets.source: generated | owner-supplied | licensed-stock | own-capture, with the URL or path of the origin
assets.prompt: generated assets: the exact prompt and any input asset ids; otherwise null
assets.model: generated assets: the model that produced it; otherwise null
assets.licence: licence or usage right, with the document or URL that grants it
